notes.title: Hotfix on Open Beta
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/418d6572d1507d61e42057d91266b65d0058aa11.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

we are continuing our work on the hotfix after the Great Ones update and this version is now available on the Open Beta. While not all issues are fixed yet, this is a first step.
We are very grateful for anyone checking out this version and of course understand that save games are different on the Open Beta branch. Any additional data will help us to pinpoint outstanding problems and verify any fixes that went in. 
We had hoped to bring you this update sooner but we are not there yet. We are still tracking to push out a hotfix update early next week, possibly as early as Monday. 

Thank you very much for anyone testing this build and we will keep you updated!
Please find all information regarding Open Beta below.

[h2]List of Fixes (pleases note that not all players experience this issues)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Not being able to create new trophy lodge
[*] Not being able to save taxidermized animals
[*] Players losing trophy lodges should see a small improvement but our work continues
[*] Skin variations in trophy lodges should now be correct for newly placed animals.
[*] Fixed a crash when entering trophy lodges related to reindeer and caribou
[*] Fixes for spawn rate for rare Mouflon, Gemsbok and Kudu
[*] Fixed a crash related to harvesting female Caribou & Reindeer
[*] Fixed female Caribou & Reindeer not having antlers
[*] Fixed male Mule Deer being invisibile
[/list]


[h2]The Trailblazer Beta, what does it entail?[/h2]

It’s a chance for you to, during a limited period, experience changes to the game before they are technically “live”. It’s also a way for us to test updates without “committing” them to the main version of the game.

[h2]How long does the Trailblazer Beta run for?[/h2]

The Beta will be available from now, until Monday May 4th.

[h2]How can I get involved?[/h2]

Right-click theHunter: Call of the Wild in your Steam library and click “Properties.'' A window will open, then click the tab at the far right labeled “Betas”, you will then come to a window that looks like the one below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/4b6391d0e32d9b4d34a435c02bd34afb0782054a.jpg[/img]

Please enter the following code in the box (without the quotation marks): “CalloftheWild”, then CLICK “Check Code” (just hitting enter won’t work). You should now notice that your game will start an update, this will be the Open Beta build installing.

Note: The download can potentially be large, and this will need to be re-downloaded as you switch between the live/Open Beta clients, so those on metered internet connections please bear that in mind.

[h2]So what happens to my old build and save files?[/h2]

Nothing. When you start the Open beta client your game will be entirely “fresh”, you’ll have no save game, cash, skills etc. But don’t worry, this has NO effect on your “live” version of the game, you can switch back and forth at any time (see the next point below).

Note: We DO have a means for you to get up and running quickly in the Trailblazer Beta. Hit “Escape” and go to the Hunt Club Beta menu, there’ll be a reward there where you can claim a large sum of credits, a big XP boost and weapon score points in all categories.

DO NOT MOVE OR MESS WITH THE SAVE FILE, IF YOU DO, YOU DO SO AT YOUR OWN RISK!!!

[h2]I’ve had enough of testing the Open Beta for now, how do I go back to my normal version of the game?[/h2]

Do the initial same steps as when installing the Open Beta, but when you get to the Beta tab you should not fill in a code. Instead in the drop-down box saying “Select the beta you would like to opt into:” you simply pick “None - opt out of all beta programs” and your client will run a small update. After that, you can play the normal version of the game again. You can switch back and forth between the live version and Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme at any time during the period just by using that dropdown menu.


[h2]How do I provide feedback or report issues I’ve found during the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme?[/h2]

Please use our “Beta Feedback” board on the Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/2269193447662464628/

[h2]What do you want us to test?[/h2]

General gameplay, progress and anything related to the fixes mentioned above.

Note: You WILL need ownership to the relevant content on the live version of the game in order to test it in the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme. For example, Parque Fernando specific content would require you owning that particular DLC. That being said, you can of course join a multiplayer hosted game on that reserve should you not own it yourself.


Again, please be sure to put any feedback or bug reports you may encounter (ONLY from this beta version of the game) on the new forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/2269193447662464628/

And please see this bug reporting template that provides some guidelines of what kind of information that might be helpful to us, so we can easily read through your feedback: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/1735469327937280314/

Thank you very much for your support and for your feedback!

/theHunter: Call of the Wild team

[h1]Animal Scoring 2.0[/h1]

One of the biggest changes with the new animal scoring system, is that integrity has been replaced with a system of classes. Every species has been assigned an animal class, and ammunition is now permitted for a specified range of classes.

For example :
Whitetail Deer is a class 4 animal
European Bison is a class 9 animal
.243 ammunition is allowed for classes 2,4,3,4,5 and 6.
Therefore, .243 ammo can be used to hunt Whitetail Deer, but not European Bison.

Medals are now awarded based on the trophy rating of the harvested animal and the result of the harvest check, a set of 4 conditions you need to meet when shooting an animal. Failing to do so will result in a reduced medal rank.

The trophy rating is entirely dependent on the trophy of the animal : horns, antlers, weight, etc. and the scoring method is unique to each individual species.

All details regarding the new animal/weapon classes can be found in the in-game UI, just check your Codex.

[h1]New Feature: TruRACS (True Random Antler Configuration System)[/h1]
TruRACS randomly generates animal trophies like antlers to drastically increase the variation that you can find in the game. No trophy will look like the other any more with more than 1 million variations per species. This update introduces TruRacs for Whitetail and Blacktail deer. More animals will be added over time.

[h1]New Feature: TruSCORE[/h1]
The Harvest Screen now features information about your trophy and explains the scoring. All factors are explained for you to understand the calculation behind every trophy so you can scout for these factors when spotting new animals.

Locate the Gramophone in the Trophy Lodge and interact with it to cycle through different music that you can enjoy while spending time in the Trophy Lodge

[*] Fixed issue of not being able to join a multiplayer game even if there was a last open slot remaining
[*] Fixed issue of character standing while inside a layout blind

Here are the notes for today's Patch!

[b]New Feature: Trophy Lodge - Spring Creek Manor[/b]

Showcase your best animals in your very own Trophy Lodge. Plaques and full body mounts of different sizes allow you to present your harvests in a variety of different poses. Invite your friends to your Trophy Lodge or travel to theirs in Single and Multiplayer.
When in a reserve, open the Pause Menu, navigate to the new “Trophy Lodge” Button in the left navigation strip. Create a new Trophy Lodge from the available Lodges - Spring Creek Manor being the first available lodge. Select the newly created Trophy Lodge and “Go to Lodge” in order to travel there.
Once in your lodge, you can switch between “Edit” and “View” mode and can follow the on-screen controls.

Please note that creating a Trophy Lodge requires ownership of the Trophy Lodge DLC.
You can travel to other player’s lodges without owning the DLC.
Once a Trophy Lodge is created but the ownership is revoked, you can still travel to your created lodge but access to the Edit mode is denied until ownership is restored.

When harvesting an animal, you are now able to taxidermize or save it for later. Taxidermy comes with a cost but you can save the animal for later taxidermy.
When in the Trophy Lodge, you can access your Trophy Manager to taxidermize saved animals, retrieve already put up animals or simply browse your collection.

Avuxeni Hunters!
We are excited to announce that today marks the release of our latest addition to Vurhonga Savanna, the Lion! 

The efforts you've made under Grandfather Njabulo's guidance have borne fruit once again after the gemsbok, as Vurhonga now gets its lions back. In addition to being Vurhonga's first carnivore, it is also Call of the Wild's first ever Apex Predator. They're nomadic, prideless African lions that have been introduced into the savanna to mark their territory and give players a new challenge in the open plains of central Vurhonga. The lions of Vurhonga, much like real lions, are curious animals. They haven't been exposed to humans and don't see them as prey but as invaders. Occasionally, when a lion senses you as a threat to its life or territory, it will approach and confront you. During a confrontation, its objective is to either scare you off or kill you and your actions will determine the odds of your survival... 

This update also contains a long list of bug fixes as well as a[b] rework of spinal cords.[/b]
Given that some animals (like buffalo and bison) have very large vertebrae (spinal cord), spine shots were the easiest way to down them. With this update, the spinal cord is separated out as an own “organ” to come closer to a realistic and ethical hunting experience. Vertebrae shots are higher damage shots than other bones, but they are no longer instant kills. Also, to make vital organs more viable, such as double lung shots, we have increased the time threshold for Quick Kill Bonus from 5 to 8 seconds.

You can read more about the Lion on our Steam Store page, or find the full Lion update content summary and the patch notes below:

notes.title: [TRAILBLAZER BETA LIVE] Parque Fernando Update Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

We will be opening up the Trailblazer Beta once more over the weekend to test a potential fix to the crashes that people are experiencing after the Parque Fernando update. Please do accept our apologies for the disruption caused to those affected by this issue, we’ve been doing everything we can to minimise the time this problem is in affect and have been working solidly on investigating the fault as soon as it was brought to our knowledge

Some of you may remember the Trailblazer Beta from when we ran it previously (you may need to re-enter the password given below to re-activate the branch), for those who this may be new to please see below this post for the full instructions.

We are opening up the beta period over the weekend with two goals in mind. Firstly we can get large scale testing for the changes we’ve made to potentially fix the crash issues, secondly (and perhaps most importantly to us) it means those of you who ARE suffering from the issue can play the game in some way over the weekend until the final fix is applied next week. Regrettably, progress you make will not carry over, but at least you can take some time to explore the reserve, find some new favourite hunting spots and maybe bag some animals for fun!

Please await more news from us about the “live” update that will fix the main version of the game during the beginning of next week.

Regards,

/theHunter Call of the Wild Team

Instructions here:

[h1]The Trailblazer Programme, what does it entail?[/h1]
It’s a chance for you to, during a limited period, experience changes to the game before they are technically “live”. It’s also a way for us to test updates without “committing” them to the main version of the game.

[h1]How long does the Trailblazer Programme run for?[/h1]
The program will be available from around about now i.e. Friday December 14th (as of this post going live), until Monday 17th December, 12pm CET.

[h1]Who can take part in the Trailblazer Programme?[/h1]
At the moment it is only available for PC players due to how quickly we can deploy things on the PC platform. 

[h1]How can I get involved?[/h1]
Right-click theHunter: Call of the Wild in your Steam library and click “Properties”. A window will prompt and you click the tab at the far right labelled “Betas”, you will then come to a window that looks like the below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/e428dfc6c4101373aed943250acd6d11fa31bdf7.jpg[/img]


Please enter the following code in the box (without the quotation marks): “CalloftheWild”, then CLICK “Check Code” (just hitting enter won’t work). You should now notice that your game will start an update, this will be the Open Beta build installing.

Note: The download can potentially be large, and this will need to be re-downloaded as you switch between the live/Open Beta clients, so those on metered internet connections please bear that in mind.

[h1]So what happens to my old build and save files?[/h1]
Nothing. When you start the Open beta client your game will be entirely “fresh”, you’ll have no save game, cash, skills etc. But don’t worry, this has NO effect on your “live” version of the game, you can switch back and forth at any time (see the next point below). 

Note: We DO have a means for you to get up and running quickly in the Trailblazer Beta.  Hit “Escape” and go to the Hunt Club Beta menu, there’ll be a reward there where you can claim a large sum of credits, a big XP boost and weapon score points in all categories. 

[h1]I’ve had enough of testing the Open Beta for now, how do I go back to my normal version of the game?[/h1]
Do the initial same steps as when installing the Open Beta, but when you get to the Beta tab you should not fill in a code. Instead in the drop-down box saying “Select the beta you would like to opt into:” you simply pick “None - opt out of all beta programs”” and your client will run a small update. After that you can play the normal version of the game again. You can switch back and forth between the live version and Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme at any time during the period just by using that dropdown menu.

[h1]How do provide feedback or I report issues I’ve found during the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme?[/h1]
Please use our “Beta Feedback” board on the Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/

notes.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild - Parque Fernando Release Update
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

Thank you very much for all your early feedback and reports about our new reserve Parque Fernando!

We’ve been sifting through your comments both in the forum and on our social channels and our highest priority at the moment is to fix the issues with [b]game crashes related to AMD graphics cards[/b]. We will keep you continuously updated on our progress! 

We will also take another look at the Mule Deer to see if we can alter its appearance and make it slightly bigger. This is just a start and more feature improvements will happen - we will address them as soon as the more urgent matters (see above) are resolved.

While we continue the work on our next patch, here are a couple of work-around tips to help in case you experience any of these issues:

[h1]
[b]Stuck on the mission “The Gold Mine” [/b][/h1]
Make sure to retreat back to the position the game tells you to, after you’ve placed the dynamite. If you missed that step, and the mission objective does not progress, try going back to the original position where you placed the dynamite and place it again but this time shoot it from the position that the game communicates. Hope this helps and thank you to Zachious for providing us with the solution! 
[h1][b]Need zones discovered by guests don’t save for the host[/b][/h1]
When you host a multiplayer game and guest players discover a need zone, this is currently not saved in your own single player game. The host (i.e. you) has to discover another need zone in order for the guest found need zones to be saved.

Keep the great feedback coming! The more detailed you can be when you write us reports, the easier we can figure out how to solve your issues as we want you to experience the beauty and thrill of Parque Fernando without hitting any snags. 

All the best,

Your theHunter: Call of the Wild team

Hello Hunters!

As many of you know we are currently experiencing issues with callers not working as they should.  Our original goal was to have this hotfixed yesterday/today, but after we’ve dug into the issue further we aren’t able to reach that deadline without the potential to introduce further problems.  It’s great to react fast when possible, but reacting fast is always very risky as it comes at the expense of proper testing.  With this in mind we will performing a rollback to Patch 1.24. Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.20.1
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Before anything else we want to start this update by saying - thank you for playing theHunter: Call of the Wild, for your ongoing support, for sending in bug reports, for giving feedback and for openly talking about the pros and the cons of our game - it’s all of great help to us, not just in the present but also going forward, as we continue to build and expand upon our hunting universe.

Yesterday’s release was not on par with yours, or our, expectations so we wanted to give you an update on what we are currently doing.

A new patch has been released to address crash fixes. This patch will not fix all crash issues but should be a step in the right direction.

Stability and fixing the crashes is our top priority now.
Additional things that are still in the works are the issue regarding not being able to place decoys (it is is related to what reserve that is being loaded first), also work regarding Geese getting stuck is progressing.

If you are experiencing the problem of not being able to place decoys, a restart of your game (Exit to Desktop) and/or a restart of your computer has helped some people. If you have more information or questions regarding this, we recommend you check this thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1696049513784910216/

Placing 20 decoys per interest area will give you very good chances of breaking a flock. Dismantling decoys to have less in the world has helped people with performance.

And finally don’t forget to update your drivers as some performance issues might stem for them being outdated.

Our work continues and we will have another update with progress for you tomorrow.

notes.title: Patch 1.20 - Geese, SXS Shotgun & more
notes.notes:

Hello Hunters,

The first flying animal of theHunter: Call of the Wild, the Canada Goose, has arrived!

The newest addition to theHunter: Call of the Wild’s animal family brings a new and exciting hunting experience to the game. Jump into Hirschfelden and  scout the skies  for skeins (flocks) of Geese in their typical V-formation.
Once you spot a flock, get out of sight and then use the new Canada Goose Short Reed caller to make them break formation and lure them to the ground. As always in hunting, patience is a virtue, so take your time and let them come close. If you manage to stay undetected, the Geese will land around you. Landing and take off, should you spook them after they have landed, are the prime opportunities to take a shot. .
We do not recommend shooting  geese high up in the air as this will spook the flock and most likely won’t hit the bird.

Alternatively, a new Layout blind and Canada Goose decoys allow you to set up the perfect hunting spot. The corn and straw fields are highly recommended as geese avoid landing in forests. The decoys, available in 3 different variations, increase your chances of successfully luring Geese to come to the ground while the layout blind offers better camouflage, overwatching the field. This allows you to lure down geese close to you, pop out of the blind and take aim.

However you choose to hunt geese, the new Strecker SXS 20G Shotgun, loaded with birdshot (also offers buck and slug) is a safe bet for ethical and high scoring hunting. The gun comes in four different variations.  We hope you like it!

The Canada Goose and Canada Goose Short Reed caller are available for free with this update.
The Strecker SXS 20G, Layout blind and Decoys are included in the new “Wild Goose Chase Gear” DLC. Upon purchase you will receive 5 of each decoy variation and one layout blind in the in-game storage, while the new gun along with the new ammunition is then unlocked in the in-game shop (no further cost).

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3745/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Head_Start_Bundle_Limited_time_offer/

Your feedback is crucial to us. You have been asking for bird hunting for a long time and today marks the beginning. We hope you are happy with the result and rest assured that we will take in your feedback and continue the work, not only on geese but on much more!

We addressed issues regarding placeable items and the beaver and hope that this improves the current situation, please let us know if you still encounter this issue!

Thank you for your ongoing support and happy hunting!

Your

Hello Hunters,

During the last few months, we’ve been hard at work on integrations of our branches, which will allow for faster development and releases of new content in the future. While this is going to improve the experience for all players, our push to get it done has also meant a recent break in our continuous rollout of PC patches.
 
With this work mostly done, we are now aiming to once again pick up the pace with more frequent PC updates. This patch will lay down the groundwork for everything that is on the horizon.

This first update mainly focuses on changes “under the hood” in order to get ready for the next updates, including the previously announced Jackrabbit. That being said, some issues will be addressed in this patch already. Animal teleportation has been a big focus for us, and this patch aims to solve the “zipping” of animals. We will continue our work on areas that affect this unwanted animal behavior and aim to have more updates going forward.

All outposts now feature interiors and can thus be entered. This was already possible in Medved-Taiga and is now also available in Layton Lake and Hirschfelden. Enjoy those cozy log cabins!

This update also takes in improvements for user interface that have only been available on the console version so far.

Last but not least we invite everyone to celebrate the Lantern Festival with us on March 2. The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Chinese New Year spring festival period and is traditionally celebrated with family, friends, and of course, lanterns! For a limited time, you can find decorations at every outpost in the game, and we wish everybody good fortune!

As always you can find all changes below and do let us know your feedback!

Happy Hunting
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Update 1.17 - Lantern Festival
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/6feb64575543ed37377d5afbce8b780a01cd888a.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

During the last few months, we’ve been hard at work on integrations of our branches, which will allow for faster development and releases of new content in the future. While this is going to improve the experience for all players, our push to get it done has also meant a recent break in our continuous rollout of PC patches.
 
With this work mostly done, we are now aiming to once again pick up the pace with more frequent PC updates. This patch will lay down the groundwork for everything that is on the horizon.

This first update mainly focuses on changes “under the hood” in order to get ready for the next updates, including the previously announced Jackrabbit. That being said, some issues will be addressed in this patch already. Animal teleportation has been a big focus for us, and this patch aims to solve the “zipping” of animals. We will continue our work on areas that affect this unwanted animal behavior and aim to have more updates going forward.

All outposts now feature interiors and can thus be entered. This was already possible in Medved-Taiga and is now also available in Layton Lake and Hirschfelden. Enjoy those cozy log cabins!

This update also takes in improvements for user interface that have only been available on the console version so far.

Last but not least we invite everyone to celebrate the Lantern Festival with us on March 2. The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Chinese New Year spring festival period and is traditionally celebrated with family, friends, and of course, lanterns! For a limited time, you can find decorations at every outpost in the game, and we wish everybody good fortune!

As always you can find all changes below and do let us know your feedback!

Happy Hunting
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

KNOWN ISSUES: 

Tents are appearing in the wrong locations in-game (too high/in the ground). We are currently working on a hotfix to address that, apologies for the inconvenience caused.

For the Chinese localized version of the client text is displaying incorrectly, this too is currently being addressed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*]As a part of Lantern Festival celebrations statues and lanterns can be found in the reserve.  Limited time.
[*]All Outposts now feature interiors that can be entered to rest[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list][*]Animal teleportation and pathfinding has been improved. This should alleviate the current problem of “zipping” animals. We are continuing the work so expect further updates on this in the future
[*]All weapons have their zeroing set specifically for their ammo. This is most noticeable on bows where 300gr arrows would hit higher and 600gr arrows would hit much lower on the zeroed distance.
[*]Significantly reduced the amount that wind affects arrow trajectories
[*]Added new outpost to Layton Lake - Balmont Railroad Outpost
[*]Default selection of starting reserve has been changed to Layton Lake
[*]Tritium sights - Fixed models and tritium sights not attaching first time, or staying attached to the weapon after switching equipment or holstering the weapon.
[*]Animals should no longer spawn in front of players
[*]Improved sound mix for Coyote and Red Foxes
[*]Sound Fix for Brown Bear warning calls[/list]

[h1]Missions[/h1]
[*]With the exception of unlocking the first mission in a Side Mission arc, Side Mission arcs in Layton Lake and Hirschfelden no longer require progress through the Main Mission arcs
[*]JÄGER - A PICTURE FOR HER BOOK - adjusted the photo parameters to make it easier to take a suitable picture
[*]FLEISCHER: A TROPHY TO REMEMBER - changed the required game score from GOLD to BRONZE
[*]TRAMPFINE: THE RETURN OF BEAR MAN - adjusted the photo parameters to make it easier to take a suitable picture
[*]VUALEZ: WILDLIFE CONTROL - made the Jackrabbit Caller objective optional
[*]VUALEZ: THE BIG COYOTE TOUR - Only need to harvest coyotes from 2 regions instead of 5
[*]VUALEZ: A SILENT HUNT - required coyotes harvests changed from 3 to 2
[*]CONNORS: CAPTURING THE LANDSCAPE - locations of landmarks are given on the map when mission is selected
[*]CONNI #10 - removed game score requirement
[*]CONNI #15 - changed game score requirement from GOLD to SILVER
[*]CONNI #19 - required fox harvests changed from 4 to 2
[*]JÄGER #2 - removed the location requirement
[*]JÄGER #3 - removed the night time requirement and the location requirement
[*]JÄGER #4 - removed the trophy score requirement
[*]JÄGER #5 - changed the required harvest animal from fallow deer to any animal
[*]JÄGER #7 - changed the required harvest animal from fallow deer to any animal, removed scoring requirement
[*]SOMMER #8 - changed the required weight requirement from >= 30 kg to >= 25 kg
[*]TRESSLER #4 - removed game score requirement and weight requirement
[*]TRESSLER #6 - required boar harvests changed from 4 to 2, required equipment changed from the .454 Rhino to any handgun
[*]DOC #2 - removed the animal color variation requirement
[*]DOC #4 - changed the required harvest animal from black bear to any animal
[*]DOC #5 - removed the weight requirement and changed the maximum shot distance from 30 meters to 40 meters 
[*]DOC #6 - changed the required harvests from 3 to 2, removed GOLD game score requirements, and added requirement for black bears harvests to have 100% Quick Kill bonus
[*]DOC #7 - removed game score requirements
[*]DOC #9 - there weren’t many bears in Kraken Highs, so we changed the required hunting location to Mount Kraken; we also removed the animal weight requirements
[*]DOC #14 - adjusted mission to allow for a wider range of photographs
[*]DOC #17 - changed the required completions from 2 to 1, removed the requirement to use a bow, removed the requirement to hunt from a specific location
[*]DOC #20 - removed game score requirement, removed the night time hunting requirement
[*]DOC #22 - changed the minimum shot distance from 150 meters away to 75 meters away
[*]DOC #23 - removed the game score requirement and added requirement for 100% Quick Kill Bonus
[*]DOC #24 - changed the required completions from 3 to 2, adjusted the minimum animal weight requirement from 85 kg to 70 kg
[*]DOC #25 - adjusted the minimum shot distance from 250 meters away to 150 meters away
[*]DOC #27 - removed GOLD game score requirement and added requirement for 100% Quick Kill Bonus
[*]DOC #30 - changed the required completions from 3 to 2
[*]HOPE #2 - changed mission requirement to Harvest 2 blacktail deer but not at night
[*]HOPE #3 - changed mission to harvest 2 male blacktail deer and earn a Quick Kill Bonus of 50 or higher
[*]HOPE #5 - changed required animal harvest species from blacktail deer to whitetail deer
[*]HOPE #7 - changed required animal harvest species from blacktail deer to whitetail deer
[*]VUALEZ #2 - removed night time harvest requirement
[*]VUALEZ #4 - mission reworked to harvesting a coyote with an Integrity bonus of 100
[*]VUALEZ #6 - changed the required completions from 4 to 2, removed coyote gender requirement

[*]CONNORS #4 - change minimum shot distance from 200 meters away to 125 meters away and removed weapon requirements

[*]Added scent eliminator duration to item description[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list][*]Added the .270 Stradivarius to the in-game shop

[h1]World[/h1]

notes.title: Hunt Club Beta - Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

we wanted to give you a bit more insight into how the Hunt Club Beta is performing, what changes have been made and how the payout of rewards will work regarding these changes.

First of all, we are very happy and thankful that many of you jumped directly into the Hunt Club Beta! This is only the beginning, but it is vastly more helpful to develop the feature alongside all of you, than in an isolated development environment.

We had a couple of hiccups during launch, but thanks to the weekend dedication of Calle, our Back End programmer, the system seems to be holding its ground so far.
Initial feedback has been excellent, based on early findings we’ll put more work into making the feature easier to understand, easier to read and will look into what other rewards are possible among other things. Thanks a lot for all the suggestions and discussions and please do keep them coming!

We are currently seeing an issue for our Chinese hunters who can’t participate in the Hunt Club Beta. Your participation is not registered by the system, which also does not let you claim rewards. We don’t have a solution yet, but we’ve located the cause of the issue and will continue to investigate a potential solution.

Rest assured that you will receive the .270 Stradivarius if the community succeeds in reaching the goal. You might receive it a bit later than the rest, but you will get it.

In regard that so many hunters can’t participate in the Holiday Event, we decided to reduce the needed harvests from 300.000 to 200.000.
This change should already be visible in your Hunt Club if you look at the number of needed harvests. Please note that the progress bar might not update this change correctly.

As a final update, the leaderboard segment of the Hunt Club Beta has been taken down for the time being. We’ve received plenty of data and feedback to work with and appreciate all of your contributions.  Watch this space for the next version in 2018

More events will go live throughout December, so please do check out the Hunt Club on a daily basis.

Happy Hunting and thank you,

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Patch 1.16 - Hunt Club
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/f6e59f82d8369f6d0529b09b3eb256d74c82ccc0.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Some of you who joined us for our stream on Tuesday may have been lucky enough to see us showing off a sneak peek of today’s big news, the addition of our new Hunt Club (beta)!

This first iteration of Hunt Club should give you plenty to do over the holiday period, and even gives a way for you to get your hands on an exclusive weapon skin!  We really hope you enjoy the fun challenges we have lined up for you.

Just to reiterate, this is a beta feature, and as such will be tweaked and changed  over the coming weeks and months. Have a look at the rest of the improvements in this patch and please do let us know your feedback via the Steam Community Hub.

Happy Hunting
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team


[b]Features[/b]
[list][*][b]Hunt Club (Beta)[/b]
The Hunt Club features daily, weekly and other hunting events in the game that you can complete for rewards. Shine as sole hunter to get a place on the global Top 10 ranks or come together as community to reap special rewards - the Hunt Club will offer variety and a reason to hunt at any time.
Please note that this feature is being released as a beta. Not everything will work flawlessly.

[*].270 STRADIVARIUS, a premium engraved variation of the .270 HUNTSMAN obtainable via the Hunt Club[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug where using multiple weapons using the same ammunition could result in a negative total ammunition count.

[*]Fixed bug where using non-weapon items aimed at other players in multiplayer would result in an “invalid target” prompt being displayed.

[*]Fixed bug where the pellet spread for the Caversham 12-gauge shotgun was very wide with all ammo types[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*]Fixed crash related to missing contextual help[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.15 - Multiplayer Spotting is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/867464710b7619e6d7f003a35bf58eb13ca71570.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

First, we want to welcome all new hunters that picked up the game during the autumn sale.  Thank you very much for giving the game a go, and welcome!

Today’s patch is mostly about maintenance and small game improvements.  Here’s some highlights:

*  Spotting animals in Multiplayer will now highlight the spotted animals for all players around the spotter. We hope this will make spotting more useful when playing with other hunters and are looking forward to your feedback.

*  The checks for animals getting stuck, especially at cliffs like the crater in the Medved-Taiga, have been improved. They should not simply disappear any longer.

*  We had some feedback from the community that the 12-gauge shotgun could give a little bit more “bang for your buck” (pun intended!), as such the 12-Gauge Buckshot’s damage has been increased per pellet and should pack a bigger punch now.

Additionally thanks to community reports the patch also features another round of fixes and improvements for missions - thank you very much for your consistent feedback and reporting!

As always, thank you very much for your feedback and let us know what you think about the latest changes.  Scroll down for the full release notes.

Happy Hunting

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

-------------------------------------------

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list][*]Multiplayer Spotting - When you spot an animal with your binoculars, all players in your proximity also see that animal highlighted in the game world.

[*]Animals no longer get stuck in cliffs

[*]Increased the 12-Gauge Buckshot’s base damage per pellet[/list]


[h1]Missions[/h1]

[list][*]MEETING GEORGY GRANKIN - implemented a fix for a bug that was blocking people from completing the mission if they had picked up Grankin’s shotgun before that objective was highlighted

[*]JÄGER #4 - removed the distance requirement for this mission

[*]SOMMER #7 - changed the required location from Spreeberg Castle to Spreeberg

[*]DOC #9 - changed the required location from Kraken Highs to Mount Kraken and removed the weight requirement

[*]HOPE #5 - changed the harvested animal from blacktail deer to whitetail deer

[*]BIOLOGICAL CONTAMINANTS #2 - changed hunting location from P’yanyy Forest to Lesnye Lands[/list]


NOTE:  You will not be able join multiplayer games of those running a lower version of the game, please ensure that you and the host are both up to date with patches should you have an issue.

Hello Hunters,

The Halloween content is ending today and is being patched out along with improvements to the game.
We hope you enjoyed this seasonal event and we want to thank everyone for participating and sharing their feedback!

In terms of improvements, today’s patch brings balancing to missions, pooping Red Deer, fixed Thoriac Spine shots on Moose, better clue handling and more.
Have a look at the list below for the full changes and let us know what you think!

Happy Hunting!
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]


[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Red Deer will now poop correctly
[*]Old clues from actively tracked animals no longer disappear randomly
[*]Fixed Thoraic Spine shots on Moose
[*]Keymapping for bringing up the chat window now works correctly
[*]Bow and arrow of other players are now held in their different hands
[*]Huntermate no longer stops working for guests in a multiplayer session
[*]Additional animations for bears when spooked[/list]

[b]Missions[/b]
[list][*]THE WERECOYOTE - Fixed an issue where the Werecoyote was not spawning for some players
[*]THE ANCESTORS’ PRAYER - Fixed an issue where players who had previously unlocked the sacred landmark were blocked from progressing in the mission
[*]CONNI #10 - Removed the game score requirement
[*]SOMMER #7  - Changed the location requirement from Spreeberg Castle to Spreeberg, the game score requirement from "GOLD or greater" to "SILVER or greater,” and the required amount of harvests from 2 to 3
[*]BHANDARI #3  - Removed the game score requirement
[*]FLEISCHER #3 - Removed game score requirement and changed the mission to require 2 harvests instead of just 1
[*]FLEISCHER #5  - Changed the location from Jonsdorf Lake to Jonsdorf and the weight requirement from 120 to 180 or greater
[*]HOPE #7  - Changed the harvest animal from blacktail deer to whitetail deer
[*]HOPE #8  - Removed shotgun requirement and changed the required amount of harvests from 1 to 2
[*]DOC #7  - Removed score requirement
[*]DOC #18  - Updated the objective description to include the bow requirement
[*]VUALEZ #9 - Removed game score requirement
[*]CONNORS #10  - Changed the total score requirement from GOLD to SILVER
[*]BEATTY #7  - Changed weight requirement from 650 to 520[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted volumes for animal vegetation passthrough
[*]Improved syncing of reload animations for shotguns (every skill level)[/list]

[b]User Interface[/b]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

notes.notes:

Hello Hunters,

This hotfix addresses issues regarding Bears freezing, critters not reacting to the player and abnormal animal behaviour.

Note: In order to enable us to deploy this patch for you as quickly as possible we have had to compromise slightly.  The bears now move as they should and can be properly hunted once more, there IS however a small animation ‘tic’ present (can be seen when the bears rears up), this will be fixed with our next normal update.  We felt that getting you all a speedy solution was more important than perfection in this particular case.


[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Bears no longer freeze when standing up
    [*]Critters no longer ignore the player
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.13.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/9132644f633ae82c384067cd5b61473f3cdd54bf.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

This hotfix addresses issues regarding Bears freezing, critters not reacting to the player and abnormal animal behaviour.

Note: In order to enable us to deploy this patch for you as quickly as possible we have had to compromise slightly.  The bears now move as they should and can be properly hunted once more, there IS however a small animation ‘tic’ present (can be seen when the bears rears up), this will be fixed with our next normal update.  We felt that getting you all a speedy solution was more important than perfection in this particular case.


[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Bears no longer freeze when standing up
    [*]Critters no longer ignore the player
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13 (featuring Halloween goodies!)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/c7a119397b6c5064816c752b34ab8358090e0339.png[/img]


[h1]Halloween is Coming to theHunter: Call of the Wild[/h1]

Hello Hunters,

It’s that time of the year, where strange goings-on are reported in the reserves, and where the hunter becomes the h(a)unted! If you dare, read on below to see what frights we have in store for you.

Features:
[list][*]Mysterious Missions in Hirschfelden including new characters.
[*]Terrifying Tasks in Layton Lake featuring new animations.
[*]Assorted Assignments in Medved-Taiga with old acquaintances.
[*]4 Halloween event achievements[/list]

Once you enter any of the three reserves from October 26th until November 8th, a new mission will present itself to you, but only our boldest hunters should heed the call.

Each reserve will have its own unique and distinct set of ghoulish missions for you to take part in, so be sure to check in on them all. Once they’ve been triggered the first time, the missions can be re-activated whenever you want from your mission log.


[b]Note for the faint of heart:[/b] You can simply choose not to follow mission instructions if you want to avoid the spooky Halloween content!

[b]Sneaky tip:[/b] There is some particularly haunting voice-acting in the new missions, enable subtitles so you don’t miss anything!


[h1]Patch 1.13[/h1]

As well as the above temporary Halloween surprises, we have some permanent changes coming with patch 1.13. Many missions have received tweaks, as well as animations and the infamous antler rattler. Read on below for the full breakdown:

Missions:
[list][*]SCENIC WEATHER #2: photography objective will now accept a greater diversity of photos and is easier to complete
[*]TAIGA MEETUP: removed photography objective from mission
[*]THE WOUNDED ONE: adjusted note objective behavior
[*]TRACKING GUNTHER: adjusted note objective behavior
NO SUCH THING: adjusted interactive objective behavior
[*]BEATTY #4: clarified the trophy score requirement for the moose
[*]JÄGER #4: clarified the exact trophy score requirements for the fallow deer[/list]

Audio:
[list][*]Antler Rattler sound fixed
[*]Improved sound material selection for animal footsteps over every reserve[/list] 

Animation:
[list][*]Fixed reindeer internal organ skinning
[*]Improved bear internal organ shoulder skinning[/list]

notes.title: Medved-Taiga Release Date Announcement and New Trailer
notes.notes:
Hi Hunters!

After a busy week welcoming PS4 and Xbox players to our reserves we have some more news to bring you about Medved-Taiga!

First up, we have a release date!  Medved-Taiga will available on Steam as of the [b]17th October, 2017[/b], that's less than two weeks away!  It will be priced at $7.99/€7.99.

Secondly, we have a new trailer to introduce you to the reserve, featuring a new personality you'll be sure to get to know better soon.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArD7Te25UGU&feature=youtu.be

Don't forget to join us for our stream today at 16:00 CEST twitch.tv/expansiveworlds

See you all there!

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.11.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/ffc87cae21edd95b5d08f17d7e05fc3e794885aa.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.11.1 is here and brings a number of new fixes to the game - we hope you’ll enjoy them! We have addressed one of the biggest issues concerning animal behavior and reactions not working as intended, sometimes making them move in a circle rather than fleeing or following a logical path. We also continued to work with a lot of your feedback to further improve the issue of disappearing tents. Please have a look at the list below for a detailed overview of all improvements introduced by this patch.
[list]
[*]Fix for a crash when entering the southwest corner of Hirschfelden.
[*]Fix for possible crash when a player leaves a multiplayer game while seated on an ATV.
[*]Fix for network de-sync when players leave a multiplayer game, causing animals to stop reacting to players.
[*]Fix for animals sometimes running in circles or not reacting to players.
[*]Additional improvements for disappearing tents.
[*]Fix for unlocalized item descriptions for bows in the store screen.
[*]Fix for rain sounds stuttering near certain areas in the game.
[*]Fix for a message about driving an ATV into the water showing for all players in a multiplayer game.
[/list]
Let us know what you think about this hotfix in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1473095965287785867/?tscn=1504722947/]Patch 1.11 feedback thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting,

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

EDIT: The reason why the patch is 1.8GB is that we have re-modeled some parts of the landscape to fix related crashes. These changes are very heavy in file size.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/07fa5d8223f2345c9d326a535fa882114e1bf164.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.11 is here and brings a wide variety of new fixes to the game that we hope you’ll enjoy!

Backpacks have arrived as a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/706150/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Backpacks/]free DLC and are now available[/url] in the Steam store! They allow you to carry more equipment and are visible on your character. 

Manual Reload and Chambering now allows for greater control over your shots and weapons. The resulting slightly reduced recoil will help you to better track the hit reactions of animals. You can find these two options in the Game settings.

The inventory system has been reworked with the aim to make it a lot more intuitive to use for both keyboards as well as game pads. Item highlighting, for example, will make it easier and much faster to get an overview of which equipment and ammunition are compatible with your carried weapons.

We’ve added additional fixes to disappearing tents and ground blinds, while also adding a check so that every player always has at least 5 tents and 5 ground blinds (counting across storage, inventory and placed in the world) owned at any time. We will monitor how this works - please let us know what you think in the feedback thread.

On top of the above mentioned, this patch introduces many more fixes such as temporal antialiasing (find it in the Graphics settings), balancing of missions, fixes for bleeding rates and animal behaviour, a new death sequence when the player dies, new animations for bears, automated codex entries when interacting with point of interests, and much more.

As always you can find the full list of changes below and we are looking forward to your feedback in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1473095965287785867/]dedicated forum thread for Patch 1.11[/url]. 

Happy Hunting

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Manual Reload[/b]
Enabling the ‘Manual Reload’ option in the Game settings allows you to manually reload your weapons. Once your magazine clip is empty, it won’t be reloaded automatically if the option is enabled. 
[*][b]Manual Chambering[/b]
Enabling the ‘Manual Chambering’ option in the Game settings allows you to manually chamber the next shot. After taking a shot, you then easily chamber the next bullet by pressing the reload button.This will allow you to better track your shots and the hit reactions of animals.
[*]Temporal Anti-Aliasing
[/list]
[h1]Missions[/h1]
[list]
[*]A Family Picture: changed objective from taking a photo of 2 bears in one photo to a two photos of 2 different bears.
[*]Jäger #4: changed deer rank requirement from GOLD to SILVER and added a distance requirement
[*]Jäger #7: changed deer rank condition from GOLD to SILVER
[*]Sommer #2: removed the high scoring animal requirement. 
[*]Sommer #7: changed the amount of GOLD score roe deer harvests needed from 4 to 2
[*]Beatty #4: changed trophy rating from GOLD to SILVER and tweaked photography parameters to make it easier to take a suitable photo
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Animal bleed rates were adjusted 
[*]Animals no longer get stuck when luring them to an outpost
[*]Animals no longer leave trails of need zones
[*]Improved fleeing behaviour of animals with less running in circles (this will be tweaked further in the future)
[*]Added player death sequence and ragdoll
[*]Updated hit reaction and injured animations for bears
[*]Fixed display bug with “Ranger” perk regarding distances
[/list]
[h1]Tents and Ground Blinds[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added check for players to always have at least 5 Tents and 5 Ground Blinds (combined between your storage, inventory and in the world)
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Inventory System
[*]Improved rendering of in-game player names
[*]Codex is now opened automatically when interacting with landmarks and cairns - this also works retroactively
[*]Added player death notifications in the chat log
[*]Player name colors now match player icons on the map
[*]Scrolling with the mouse wheel while the map is hidden no longer affects the zoom level of the map
[*]New message displaying when player have been kicked from a multiplayer game
[*]Added contextual help for ATV when entering for the first time
[*]Added setting to display/hide the HUD.
[*]Multiplayer harvest messages in the chat will now display the accumulated harvest score for the animal harvested instead of the base animal score.
[*]Fixed issue where the player’s heart rate would get inappropriately updated while on an ATV
[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]ATVs now create sounds when passing through vegetation like bushes
[*]Exchanged the voice over line for “There is a track nearby”
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Anti-Aliasing graphical setting
[*]Fixed hand textures on female variation #5
[*]Terrain tessellation now correctly matches physics settings after changing map
[*]Travel-related achievements will now work correctly for new players
[*]Fixed one issues that could cause the game to freeze
[/list]
[h1]Tobii[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes for crashes related to Extended View
[/list]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/8352fe6d14e306419356e3712270500f94807cae.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

We're excited to finally release the first big patch after the summer break, introducing some major improvements to multiplayer as well as other areas of the game. 

In general multiplayer updates can be challenging as testing them is complex. The issues can have several different reasons for happening and even though we feel confident enough to release the patch we will monitor game data, and your reports, to make sure that we catch any additional problems. As always, your feedback is very important to us and we are looking forward to it!

So what is new in Patch 1.10? Well, glad you asked! Progressing with friends is now more convenient, as all players in a multiplayer game are able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Additional improvements to host migration and networking will prevent issues like invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more.

Some other highlights are customizable track colors (helpful for players suffering from deuteranopia i.e. red-green color blindness), a new chat window, new predator “distressed” caller and a new setting to hide the HUD. You can find the full patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the update and let us know what you think in the dedicated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2183537632737145117/]Patch 1.10 forum thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]All players in a multiplayer game are now able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Any outpost, lookout tower or hunting structure claimed by another player still needs to be claimed by you in order to use its functionality (e.g. resting, store, etc.) Structures that have been claimed by other players in a multiplayer session are now marked as “Ghost” models for better indication.
[*]Your progress will be carried over to singleplayer and any future multiplayer game.
[*]Improved updating of animal health in multiplayer
[*]Overhauled host migration
[*]Major improvements to network functionality in order to prevent random issues in multiplayer (e.g. invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more) 
[*]Fixed issue where the heart rate indicator would not function properly when in multiplayer games.
[/list]
We took a big sweep at multiplayer in this update, mostly focusing on how you play and progress together. These won’t be the last improvements in multiplayer as getting more data from you is very important for fixing and improving this aspect of the game. We will closely monitor the results to keep improving multiplayer.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with lost Huntermate in Multiplayer and Singleplayer
[*]Improved ATV suspension to prevent wheels from offsetting
[*]Fixed a bug that caused weapons to pop in and out of the player’s hands
[/list]
[b]Tents and Ground Blinds[/b]
[list]
[*]Ground blinds no longer disappear when buying them from a nearby tent
[*]Fixed issue with tents and ground blinds sometimes disappearing for some players in multiplayer games
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Added setting for color variations to active / inactive tracks and collectibles
[*]Chat window has received an overhaul
[*]HUD can now be enabled / disabled in the Settings
[*]Settings are now correctly saved when exiting the navigation strip
[*]Added Weapon Score information to Hunter Profile Card
[*]Unlimited ammunition is no longer displayed when entering the shooting range with a weapon without ammunition
[*]Skill points now center correctly in the skill node
[*]Setting the compass to “fixed” now works properly with only the needle rotating
[*]Headings in the multiplayer game browser are now localised
[*]Current time when resting no longer misses zeroes 
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased volume for ATVs
[*]New sound for Predator - “Distressed” caller
[*]Decreased volume of footsteps in water when sneaking
[*]Adjusted volume of first aid kit in multiplayer based on distance to user
[*]Rain at Petershain Fields now plays properly
[*]Characters no longer play audio during loading screens
[*]Improved breathing sounds for male characters while running
[*]Decreased volume of breathing for female characters while running
[*]Added holstering sounds for rifles
[*]Zooming in our out with rifle scopes no longer skips the click when done too quickly
[/list]

In general multiplayer updates can be challenging as testing them is complex. The issues can have several different reasons for happening and even though we feel confident enough to release the patch we will monitor game data, and your reports, to make sure that we catch any additional problems. As always, your feedback is very important to us and we are looking forward to it!

So what is new in Patch 1.10? Well, glad you asked! Progressing with friends is now more convenient, as all players in a multiplayer game are able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Additional improvements to host migration and networking will prevent issues like invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more.

Some other highlights are customizable track colors (helpful for players suffering from deuteranopia i.e. red-green color blindness), a new chat window, new predator “distressed” caller and a new setting to hide the HUD. You can find the full patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the update and let us know what you think in the dedicated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2183537632737145117/]Patch 1.10 forum thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]All players in a multiplayer game are now able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Any outpost, lookout tower or hunting structure claimed by another player still needs to be claimed by you in order to use its functionality (e.g. resting, store, etc.) Structures that have been claimed by other players in a multiplayer session are now marked as “Ghost” models for better indication.
[*]Your progress will be carried over to singleplayer and any future multiplayer game.
[*]Improved updating of animal health in multiplayer
[*]Overhauled host migration
[*]Major improvements to network functionality in order to prevent random issues in multiplayer (e.g. invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more) 
[*]Fixed issue where the heart rate indicator would not function properly when in multiplayer games.
[/list]
We took a big sweep at multiplayer in this update, mostly focusing on how you play and progress together. These won’t be the last improvements in multiplayer as getting more data from you is very important for fixing and improving this aspect of the game. We will closely monitor the results to keep improving multiplayer.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with lost Huntermate in Multiplayer and Singleplayer
[*]Improved ATV suspension to prevent wheels from offsetting
[*]Fixed a bug that caused weapons to pop in and out of the player’s hands
[/list]
[b]Tents and Ground Blinds[/b]
[list]
[*]Ground blinds no longer disappear when buying them from a nearby tent
[*]Fixed issue with tents and ground blinds sometimes disappearing for some players in multiplayer games
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Added setting for color variations to active / inactive tracks and collectibles
[*]Chat window has received an overhaul
[*]HUD can now be enabled / disabled in the Settings
[*]Settings are now correctly saved when exiting the navigation strip
[*]Added Weapon Score information to Hunter Profile Card
[*]Unlimited ammunition is no longer displayed when entering the shooting range with a weapon without ammunition
[*]Skill points now center correctly in the skill node
[*]Setting the compass to “fixed” now works properly with only the needle rotating
[*]Headings in the multiplayer game browser are now localised
[*]Current time when resting no longer misses zeroes 
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased volume for ATVs
[*]New sound for Predator - “Distressed” caller
[*]Decreased volume of footsteps in water when sneaking
[*]Adjusted volume of first aid kit in multiplayer based on distance to user
[*]Rain at Petershain Fields now plays properly
[*]Characters no longer play audio during loading screens
[*]Improved breathing sounds for male characters while running
[*]Decreased volume of breathing for female characters while running
[*]Added holstering sounds for rifles
[*]Zooming in our out with rifle scopes no longer skips the click when done too quickly
[/list]

As mentioned in yesterday’s patch notes we have some more improvements to release today with patch 1.9.1.
 
Animals no longer think you are on an ATV after dismounting, as their vision was affected. We also introduced further improvements to the repopulation of animals, group behaviour specifically.
 
Tents should no longer disappear and we are working on a solution to compensate for lost ones. More information regarding this will follow soon, we want to make sure that nothing gets lost. 
 
Trophy integrity now only calculates first hits when using weapons shooting multiple projectiles such as shotguns.
 
Time and weather will now only save for the host and will work correctly in multiplayer.

[/list]

Today, we roll out patch 1.9 with some subtle improvements.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/a2ad93650dece70c7ea8ae7300961bbdc202f6fe.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
Before we bring you the ATV DLC - which will be out soon - we wanted to release a patch to fix issues that have been of concern to the community.
 
Patch 1.8 introduces the new outposts in both Hirschfelden and Layton Lake while also updating the animal respawn system. This fixes the exploit near Lake Kraken too. Please note that this will remove your discovered need zones. The empty tutorial box that got stuck after harvesting an animal has been fixed as well.
 
After releasing the Shooting Range, players requested improved feedback for shot placement and we are happy to release this feature as well. The terrain on low-quality settings will also no longer obstruct targets, and buttons can only be used from within the control room.
 
Multiplayer is high on our list of improvement areas, and this patch introduces some first steps, but you can expect more of this in the future.
Bullet trajectories and scopes are now correctly synchronized in multiplayer, so you will see exactly where shots of other players land, for all weapons. We made additional changes to how your rewards are communicated when you harvest an animal of a shared takedown. Instead of showing the total rewards, you will now see the rewards you receive based on your participation. Filtering multiplayer games by distance now works correctly and the default amount of players when creating a multiplayer session has been increased to 8.
 
The previously announced adjustments to Tents & Ground Blinds roll out with this patch. Purchasing the Tents & Ground Blinds DLC from now on will grant 5 tents and 5 ground blinds, while players who bought additional tents and / or ground blinds beforehand, will be refunded their in-game currency, corresponding to a maximum of 5 tents and 5 ground blinds.
 
This is not all, as we made balance changes to missions, aiming to make them fairer to complete. As always, you can find the full list below and we are looking forward to your feedback while continuing to improve the game.
 
Let us know what you think about the changes in our 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2119355556474605026/]dedicated forum thread[/url] and we look forward to bringing you the ATV DLC shortly.
 
Happy Hunting!
 
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Shooting Target HUD - As requested by many players, now you can get instant visual feedback about where your bullet lands on the Shooting Range targets so you can further improve your hunting skills!
[*]6 additional outposts have been added to Hirschfelden (will appear revealed on the map if closest lookout tower has been claimed)
[*]7 additional outposts have been added to Layton Lake (will appear revealed on the map if closest lookout tower has been claimed)
[*]You can find a map overview of the new outposts at the bottom of this post
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the terrain covering targets at the shooting range (low quality settings)
[*]Animals now correctly repopulate after being killed but not harvested
[*]Fixed animal exploit near lake Kraken
[*]No longer possible to trigger toggle target buttons from outside the control room
[*]Fixed issue with lever action giving shotgun stats instead of rifle stats
[*]Fixed issue with aim toggle resetting after confirming an animal
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Bullet trajectories now work correctly for other players in multiplayer
[*]Scopes are now correctly shown and updated in multiplayer
[*]When harvesting an animal with a shared takedown, players now receive the correct information about their own reward
[*]Filtering multiplayer games by distance now works correctly
[*]Default amount of maximum players when creating a multiplayer game increased from 2 to 8
[*]Additional names for multiplayer competitions
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in the mission “Jäger - Wrapping Up The Book” where not all objective regions were marked on the map
[*]Tweaked the conditions for completing the photo objectives in “Jäger - [*]Wrapping Up The Book”  to make them easier to complete
[*]Changed the objective in the mission “Conni #18” to require a weapon and distance that makes more sense for the targeted species
[*]Fixed an issue with the mission “Connors - Putting out the fire” where the campfire was burning before the mission had been activated by the player
[*]Fixed an issue where the fire in the mission "Connors - Putting out the fire" failed to show if you exited the fire location and returned to it when the mission was active
[*]Fixed an issue with the mission “Conni #20” where Foxes harvested from ground blinds did not count correctly towards the objective
[*]The mission system no longer gets stuck when quitting or crashing when the last objective of a mission is met
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with empty tutorial box that is stuck after animal harvest
[*]Longest shot, shot accuracy, shots fired, shots hit and shots missed now track correctly for local player only
[*]Fixed First Aid Key placeholder in contextual tutorial
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with vegetation textures when switching reserves
[*]Fixed issue with the flashlight not being toggleable
[*]Fixed various floating assets
[*]Added vegetation interaction objects to various assets (e.g. grass will be lower around benches and similar objects)
[/list]
[b]Tents & Ground Blinds[/b]
[list]
[*]Number of Tents and Ground Blinds awarded upon DLC purchase increased from 1 to 5
[*]Refunded players who previously bought additional tents and ground blinds for up to 4 additional Tents/Ground Blinds with in-game currency
[*]Vegetation no longer sticks through tents
[/list]

[h1]New outposts on Hirschfelden & Layton Lake District[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/747c311e8cb39bc2b3ee79148be841d63d8bf81e.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/46b9b43c8234c9262386330211f7156d38c1612b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Announcing ATV Saber 4x4 & Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/00e830b2aca92ef673d059af1f060f874888efce.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
We hope you’ve enjoyed the jigsaw puzzle challenge and are as excited about the upcoming DLC release as we are. As many of you have correctly guessed, we will be adding an All Terrain Vehicle (ATV) to the theHunter: Call of the Wild! The lucky winners of our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/1326721370049309433]Steam competition[/url] are Bishop, Xi Law, Harkon[DGA], Climply & djiskool. I will reach out to the winners via Steam.
 
The ATV has been a highly requested feature in the theHunter franchise for many years, and with the new Apex technology powering theHunter: Call of the Wild, we finally felt that we could do it justice. The brand new Saber 4x4 ATV will be released soon via Steam for $3.99.

Reveal Trailer:
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ry93SPMvesE&feature=youtu.be
An ATV offers the perfect way to traverse the hunting reserves in a fun, yet efficient way. You can, of course, drive it in singleplayer games, but also in multiplayer. Only one player needs to own the DLC for all of you to enjoy it. Before we get into the details, we just want to be clear that we’re still committed to fair and ethical hunting. To that end, you will never be shooting while you’re riding, and you can’t run down animals as you ride. The ATV was designed as a mode of (really fun!) transportation across great distances.
 
As a gesture of appreciation to our most loyal players, everyone who already owns the “Tents & Ground Blinds” DLC, as well as all the early birds who purchase the brand new 'Mile a minute' DLC bundle (ATV + Tents & Ground Blinds), will receive a 30 percent discount. This is a limited time offer and only available for 7 days after the release of the ATV.
 
As promised, we also have an exciting update, available to everyone. Together with this new optional DLC, we’ll release Patch 1.8 which will contain the regular bug fixes and performance improvements. Hello Hunters,

We hope you are well. Today we're excited to introduce Patch 1.7 featuring the first ever shooting range in theHunter: Call of the Wild!

Get a feeling for all weapons, practice your aim, investigate the ballistics in detail without using up ammunition or challenge your friends to a shoot-off to crown the best shot. The shooting range is located in Rathenfeldt, offering target distances from 50 to to 500 meters. You can find more detailed information about the shooting range [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/640230/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Shooting_Range/]here[/url].

We hope you enjoy the shooting range, and look forward to your feedback and shooting scores!

This patch also features a couple of bug fixes that you have been requesting, and we aim to deliver more of those shortly. You can find the full list at the end of this post. The announced adjustments and compensation for Tents & Groundblinds are still being worked on and will be released soon. We will make a dedicated announcement about it once we’re ready.

You can discuss the latest patch in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1290691308588068724/]dedicated forum thread[/url].

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

[list]
[*]Items should now unlock when requirements are already met

[*]Tents & Groundblinds go to the backpack after dismantling (instead of storage)
[*]Fixed issue with outposts being permanently locked (you have to walk in range of 500m for it to update)
[*]Fix for outposts not being unlocked on clients when being unlocked on host
[*]Reworked fall damage
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for tracks highlight setting getting turned off when harvesting an animal
[*]Fix for button prompts getting stuck after exiting to main menu
[*]Various localization fixes
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Sound mix adjustment for callers
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Lights at lodges no longer flicker
[*]Firewood stands now has correct collision
[*]Fix for various floating objects
[/list]

Hello Hunters,

With patch 1.62, a new issue appeared which in some cases would make already discovered outposts and points of interest disappear from players’ maps. This would also lead to fast travel options not being available anymore for affected players. The issue has now been resolved. 
A second issue we fixed with this patch is crashes of the game when using the fast travel option of tents. Unfortunately this has introduced a minor graphical bug where the marker of a tent will stay visible on the map even after dismantling it. We are also aware that some players are reporting the loss of their purchased tents and ground blinds from their inventories and storage spaces. We’re already working on a solution for this issue which we will implement as soon as possible.

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Discovered POI and Outposts will no longer disappear

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/7ac5724135684c01be4a4157cb647cfe2aeaac55.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

We hope you’ve had a great Easter weekend with your family and friends. Hopefully you had time for some gaming as well. And as a belated Easter gift - here is Patch 1.6!

This week we've got some exciting fixes and new DLC in store for you (see separate post regarding the latter). As we mentioned in Patch 1.5, we pushed the 'Exit to main menu' button out a bit due to other fixes taking priority, but we're happy to announce that the option is now available in the game menu.

In previous patches we’ve put a strong focus on the stability and overall performance optimization of the game, and we will continue to do so. With great help from our community, we have tracked down and fixed an issue that would cause the scope zeroing of the .338 and 7mm rifles to be inaccurate when fired in crouched position. 

Another issue we noticed is that the 'Death on spawn' bug was not fixed for all players after Patch 1.5 was released, as we continued to receive reports of it happening. This update should ensure that ‘Death on spawn’ is now part of history.

You can read the full list of fixes below - we look forward to reading your feedback and comments regarding the patch in the comment section and the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/133262848299662535/]dedicated feedback thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added “Exit to main menu” button 
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for a bug that lead to player characters death when spawning into the game.
[*]Fix for an issue that would cause .338 and 7mm rifles to not have a barrel opening to the bullet chamber 
[*]Fix for an issue with Cacciatore 12G that would cause momentary clipping when used with scopes
[*]Fix for an issue with the gamekeeper shotgun that would cause it’s rail to not correctly follow when reloading
[*]Fix for an issue with the huntermate in prone position that could cause it to momentarily “spin”
[*]Fix for a bug where aiming with a scope while crouched was inaccurate for the .338, 7mm and shotguns.
[*]Footprint clues will now properly show the approximate animal weight
[/list]
[h1]Stability fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for crash occurs when changing between windowed and full screen mode, or when alt-tabbing in and out of the game.
[*]Fix for crash if you enter deep water
[*]Fix for crash when starting a game after animal map content has changed
[*]Fix for crash when leaving a dead animal on the ground and traveling far away from it
[*]Fix for crash when bagging an animal in a multiplayer game
[/list]
